source.name: Aston Villa FC – 'Aston Villa announce Visit Rwanda partnership'
source.note: The club's own announcement. It names no back-of-shirt, shorts or patch sponsor; the SportsPro report (citing The Athletic) gives the reported value.
source.quote: Visit Rwanda’s branding will appear on the front of all men’s, women’s and academy teams’ shirts

source.name: Aston Villa FC – 'Kaizen Gaming to become Official Sleeve Partner'
source.note: The club's own announcement of the sleeve move.
source.quote: the Betano branding will now move to the sleeve

summary: The front of this shirt is paid for by the Government of Rwanda; the sleeves are Betano's after the front-of-shirt betting ban.

change.text: Worse than last season: Visit Rwanda took the front

headline: The shirt is {level}: the front sponsor, Visit Rwanda, is paid for by the Government of Rwanda.
shortLine: Visit Rwanda on the front, Betano on the sleeves
